engine_notes: Part of chain data/bosses/chains/tower_brave.json: floors are fought in order with no healing between floors; a lost battle sends the player back to floor 1 (restart_on_loss). Fleeing a floor did not reset progress (4399: 只剩一只精灵时除非胜券在握，最好逃跑).
Level shown as '??' (4399: 31~60层…等级都是能力高于100的??、???级，比玩家精灵高二十、三十级). Encoded as Lv120 for 31-50 and Lv130 for 51-60 (20-30 above the Lv100 cap).
HP is not published per floor. Two data points: 50F 水晶鸭 refills to 900; 57F 艾斯菲亚 has 750 HP. Estimates: 600 for 31-49, 750 for every 51-60 monster.
